notes:
FISCAL CALENDAR: Costco FY ends late Aug/early Sep. Q3 FY2026 = 12 weeks ended May 10, 2026. FY2025 = 52 weeks ended Aug 31, 2025. YTD (36 weeks) net sales $203.4B, net income $6.228B, EPS $14.01.

VALUATION: fwd_pe of 43.49 is from StockAnalysis aggregator (likely NTM-blended). On explicit consensus FY2026 EPS ($20.52), forward P/E = ~46.4. 5y avg forward P/E ~45.8 (sources range 44-48). On the 46.4 basis the stock trades roughly AT its 5y average; on the 43.49 basis ~5% below. Either way Costco trades at an extreme absolute multiple (~50x trailing, mkt P/E ~52). PEG 4.43 reflects rich price vs ~10-12% EPS growth. ESTIMATED valuation fields due to aggregator dependence.

NET CASH: cash & ST investments ~$20.0B vs total debt ~$8.23B = +$11.76B net cash. nd_ebitda = -11.76/13.79 = -0.85 (net cash, so leverage effectively zero/negative). Excludes ~$5B+ operating lease liabilities and the periodic special dividends Costco funds from this cash pile.

SBC: very low for a mega-cap — FY2025 SBC $860M = 0.31% of revenue, ~11% of FCF. Non-dilutive concern minimal; one of the cleanest large-cap comp structures. CRITICO R9: PASS comfortably.

ROIC: ESTIMATED ~20% (GuruFocus reports 16% on a conservative invested-capital base incl. leases; on a net-cash-adjusted operating basis Costco's ROIC is typically low-20s to mid-20s%). High-quality capital efficiency.

GUIDANCE: Costco issues NO formal financial guidance (long-standing policy). guidance_fy figures are Wall Street/S&P consensus estimates, explicitly NOT company guidance — flagged ESTIMADO.

DROP CLASSIFICATION = fear_rotation: Stock is only ~13% off its all-time high ($1,096.50 set May 2026) — barely a 'drop.' Fundamentals are ACCELERATING, not deteriorating: Q3 net sales +11.6%, comps +6.6% ex gas/fx, GAAP EPS +15% YoY ($4.93 vs $4.28), membership renewal 89.7% worldwide / 92.2% US-Canada, 148.5M cardholders. The pullback is pure multiple de-rating / profit-taking on an extremely premium-valued staple after hitting record highs — valuation-driven rotation, NOT genuine deterioration. Borderline 'not_depressed' since it remains very richly valued; classified fear_rotation because the move is sentiment/valuation, not earnings.

eps_adj = eps_gaap: Costco reports clean GAAP earnings with no recurring non-GAAP adjustments.
